parts.rubric: For each question, choose the correct answer (A, B or C). Read what three children say about their pets.
parts.title: My pet

options.title: Nora
options.text: I have a cat. Her name is Luna. She is black and white, and she is two years old. Luna sleeps on my bed every night. She likes fish and milk. She does not like water! In the morning she wakes me up at six o'clock.

options.title: Pablo
options.text: My pet is a dog. His name is Rocky, and he is very big. He is brown. Every day after school, I take Rocky to the park, and we play with a ball. He eats a lot! He sleeps in the garden, in a small house.

options.title: Yuki
options.text: I have two small fish. They are orange. They live in the kitchen. I give them food every morning before school. They are not noisy, and they are easy to look after. My little brother likes watching them.

questions.prompt: Whose pet is black and white?
questions.explanation_es: La gata de Nora: «She is black and white».

questions.prompt: Who goes outside with their pet every day?
questions.explanation_es: Pablo lleva a Rocky al parque todos los días después del colegio.

questions.prompt: Who has more than one pet?
Whose pet sleeps in the same room as them?
questions.explanation_es: Luna duerme en la cama de Nora. El perro de Pablo duerme en el jardín.
Rocky «is very big». Los peces de Yuki son pequeños.

questions.prompt: Who gives their pet food before school?
questions.explanation_es: Yuki: «I give them food every morning before school».
La gata despierta a Nora a las seis de la mañana.

parts.rubric: For each question, choose the correct answer (A, B or C).
parts.title: Daniel's week

groups.text:
Daniel is twenty-three years old. He is from Spain, but now he lives in London. He works in a hotel near the river.

Daniel starts work at seven o'clock in the morning. He goes to work by bus, because the hotel is far from his flat. He finishes at three o'clock. After work, he has lunch in a small café with his friend Mia.

On Monday and Wednesday evenings, Daniel has English classes. His teacher is very nice, and there are ten students in the class. On Fridays, he plays football in the park.

Daniel does not work at the weekend. On Saturdays he cleans his flat and goes shopping. On Sundays he phones his family in Spain. He misses them, but he likes his life in London.

questions.explanation_es: «He works in a hotel near the river». En la cafetería come, no trabaja.

questions.prompt: How does Daniel go to work?
questions.explanation_es: Va en autobús porque el hotel está lejos de su piso.

questions.prompt: When does Daniel have English classes?
questions.explanation_es: Los lunes y los miércoles por la tarde: dos tardes a la semana. Los viernes juega al fútbol.

questions.prompt: What does Daniel do on Saturdays?
questions.explanation_es: Los sábados limpia el piso y va de compras. No trabaja el fin de semana.

questions.prompt: Who does Daniel talk to on Sundays?
questions.explanation_es: «On Sundays he phones his family in Spain».

parts.text: I live in a small town near the sea. There {{19}} a big park in the centre, and there are two schools. My house is {{20}} to the park. In summer, many people {{21}} to my town, because the beach is beautiful. I like my town, {{22}} it is very quiet in winter. There is a market {{23}} Saturdays. gaps.explanation_es: Hay contraste: me gusta, pero es muy tranquilo en invierno.
Con los días de la semana se usa «on».
Tercera persona del singular («my mother»): verbo con -s.

parts.text:

parts.rubric: Write a message. Write 25 words or more.
parts.prompt:
You want to play football with your friend Sam on Saturday. Write a message to Sam.

Say:
• where you want to play
• what time
• what Sam can bring.
parts.model_answer:
Hi Sam,
Do you want to play football on Saturday? We can play in the park near my house. Let's meet at four o'clock. Please bring your ball.
Bye,
Alex
checklist_es: ¿Dices las tres cosas? Dónde, a qué hora y qué puede traer.
¿Se entiende el mensaje aunque haya algún error?

parts.rubric: Look at the three pictures. Write the story shown in the pictures. Write 35 words or more. (In the exam these are drawings; here they are described.)
parts.prompt:
Picture 1: A girl is in her kitchen. She is making a cake.

Picture 2: The girl is reading a book in the living room. There is smoke in the kitchen.

Picture 3: The girl is in a shop. She is buying a cake.
parts.model_answer: Anna wanted to make a cake for her mum's birthday. She put it in the oven. Then she read her book, and she forgot the cake. The cake was black! So Anna went to a shop and bought a cake.
checklist_es: ¿Cuentas lo que pasa en los tres dibujos, en orden?
